Small data fixtures for the rGEDI package tutorial

Measured airborne laser scanning (ALS)
Amazon.laz and Savanna.laz are lossless LAZ recompressions of Amazon.las
(19,730 returns) and Savanna.las (77,986 returns) in the original rGEDI
example data release:
https://github.com/carlos-alberto-silva/rGEDI/releases/download/datasets/examples.zip
No random points were generated or substituted. Original point attributes
are retained. The tutorial displays nominal 25 m diameter footprint clips.

Native NASA grids for Sequoia National Forest, California
GEDI03_Sequoia.tif: rh100_mean (m) and counts (number of observations).
Source: GEDI L3 Land Surface Metrics, Version 2, 2019 day 108 to 2021 day 216.
https://data.ornldaac.earthdata.nasa.gov/protected/gedi/GEDI_L3_LandSurface_Metrics_V2/data/GEDI03_rh100_mean_2019108_2021216_002_02.tif
https://data.ornldaac.earthdata.nasa.gov/protected/gedi/GEDI_L3_LandSurface_Metrics_V2/data/GEDI03_counts_2019108_2021216_002_02.tif
GEDI04_B_Sequoia.tif: MU (AGBD, Mg/ha) and SE (cell standard error, Mg/ha).
Source: GEDI L4B Gridded Biomass, Version 2.
https://data.ornldaac.earthdata.nasa.gov/protected/gedi/GEDI_L4B_Gridded_Biomass/data/GEDI04_B_MW019MW138_02_002_05_R01000M_MU.tif
https://data.ornldaac.earthdata.nasa.gov/protected/gedi/GEDI_L4B_Gridded_Biomass/data/GEDI04_B_MW019MW138_02_002_05_R01000M_SE.tif
The Sequoia subsets retain the original EPSG:6933 cells and values without
interpolation. The geographic extraction window is approximately longitude
-119.420 to -117.910, latitude 35.276 to 36.998. Cell spacing is 1000.895 m
(nominal 1 km).

Boundary shapefiles
sequoia.*: Sequoia National Forest administrative boundary, USDA Forest Service.
https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_ForestSystemBoundaries_01/MapServer/0
Query: forestname LIKE '%Sequoia%'; forestorgcode 0513; outSR 4326.
Simplified by 50 m in UTM 11N, preserving topology. This administrative
boundary can include non-federal lands; it is not a federal ownership mask.
shenandoah.*: Shenandoah National Park boundary, US National Park Service,
UNIT_CODE SHEN, from the Land Resources Division boundary service:
https://services1.arcgis.com/fBc8EJBxQRMcHlei/arcgis/rest/services/NPS_Land_Resources_Division_Boundary_and_Tract_Data_Service/FeatureServer/2
Query: UNIT_CODE = 'SHEN'; fields UNIT_CODE, UNIT_NAME; outSR 4326.
Simplified by 20 m in UTM 17N, with topology preservation.
Both boundary examples are educational cartographic subsets, not surveyed
legal boundaries. Source agencies retain credit for the original data.

Reproducibility
The README scripts use these fixtures offline. The optional Shenandoah GEE
tutorial retrieves GEDI L4A Version 2.1, annual AlphaEarth embeddings and
NASADEM from Earth Engine. Downloaded intermediates stay in an external
cache. The global figure is a 20 km display preview of native GEDI L4B MU.
No cloud requests are performed during package installation or checking.
These fixtures support package tutorials; manuscript assets are separate.
